courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 紐約第二大道地鐵一期
related.transfer: 可遷移「快慢車追及與待避」與「周轉時間與車隊需求」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；紐約第二大道地鐵一期的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fast-slow train catch-up" and "Round-trip time and fleet size" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦機場都市分支捷運合流與車站容量；紐約第二大道地鐵一期則以深層都市地鐵建設沉陷與垂直交通為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on airport urban branched metro merging and station capacity; Second Avenue Subway Phase 1 centres on deep urban subway construction settlement and vertical circulation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「快慢車追及與待避」與「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到紐約第二大道地鐵一期，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「月台暫存與隊列守恆」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fast-slow train catch-up” and “Survey control and independent residuals”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Second Avenue Subway Phase 1, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Platform storage and queue conservation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

以「再生煞車能量與受電條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fast-slow train catch-up” and “Delay and braking distance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taiwan High Speed Rail, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Regenerative energy and receptivity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 溫哥華加拿大線
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2005 年：加拿大線工程於十一月開始建設施工；2009 年：加拿大線於八月開始旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以溫哥華加拿大線連結市中心、列治文與機場的背景，建立兩分支匯入共用核心段的教學班表。學徒分析機場行李旅客與通勤族不同上車時間，並將橋梁、終端折返與車隊配置納入同一套容量檢核。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2005: Canada Line construction began in November; 2009: Canada Line began passenger service in August. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Canada Line’s links among central Vancouver, Richmond and the airport to construct a teaching timetable with two branches entering a common core. Analyse different boarding times for airport passengers with baggage and commuters. Include bridges, terminal reversal and fleet allocation in one capacity review so that branch demand and core service are checked together. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.
